items.title: The era of AI wearables focused on listening is here
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination host Brooke DiPalma to report on the next round of wearable devices focused on listening to collect data, including built-in cameras in Meta's (META) Smart Glasses and the Apple (AAPL) Watch's use of the "Live Rewind" feature, as well as the privacy and consent concerns this could raise.

items.title: Meta's Muse Agent Makes Waves: Market Snapshot
items.summary: Major banks, insurers and online travel agencies stocks took a tumble this week after Meta's new artificial intelligence agent, Muse rose to the top of Apple's app store. Increasing usage of the app sparked fears that personal AI tools could disrupt businesses that benefit from so-called consumer inertia. The Opening Trade spoke to guests about whether the latest AI developments are impacting their outlook for stocks and the broader sector amid an increasingly complex AI trade.
